packagePaths: concept2cure-riai > @figma/code-connect@1.5.3 > zod@3.25.58 (devDependency; the only copy below 4.6.6)
entryPoints: None. Every production and application path is fixed: the root zod, which every server, shared and client import resolves to, is 4.6.7, and `npm ls zod --omit=dev --all` lists only zod@4.6.7. The one remaining copy is nested under @figma/code-connect, a design-time CLI (`figma connect`) that no npm script, CI workflow or Dockerfile stage runs; the repository has no *.figma.tsx mapping file and client/figma.config.json still carries placeholder team and file ids.
runtimeProof: The advisory (CVE-2023-54404, CWE-770) is memory exhaustion in array validation: zod accumulates one issue per failing element with no cap. Measured on zod 3.25.76 before this change: a 2 MB JSON body (the /api limit) of 1,000,000 elements against z.array(z.string()).max(10) produced 1,000,001 issues and 276 MB of heap in one synchronous parse. That path was reachable from request validation in 244 server files, so it was FIXED (zod 4.6.7), not reviewed away.

The gate checks installedVersion against the hoisted node_modules/zod, which is the fixed 4.6.7; the vulnerable copy is node_modules/@figma/code-connect/node_modules/zod@3.25.58, flagged by npm audit only through @figma/code-connect. dependencyType is `direct` because zod is a direct dependency; the vulnerable copy itself is transitive.

No parent release carries the fix: @figma/code-connect 2.1.0 (latest) pins zod 3.25.76 exactly. An override to zod 4 would break the CLI's zod 3 API use, and the CLI never parses a request: its input is this repository's config and Figma's API responses on a developer's machine.
`npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --omit=dev` (the Dockerfile runtime stage) does not install @figma/code-connect, so the runtime image has no zod below 4.6.6.
commands: git grep -nE "figma connect|code-connect" -- .github scripts Dockerfile package.json

findings.action: Keep @figma/code-connect out of every script, workflow and runtime stage while it pins zod 3. Drop the row when @figma/code-connect ships on zod >=4.6.6 (then bump it) or the dependency is removed; re-review if anything starts invoking the CLI.
